{{incomplete|needs=Confirmation that ''A Pokémon of a Different Color!'' is on disc 16.5 and not disc 16.6 in the Season 16 disc set}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the sixteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S16|Pokémon: BW Adventures in Unova and Beyond]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== Two Adventures in Unova and Beyond Collections were released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in 2014, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. ===Pokémon BW: Adventures in Unova - Collection 1=== [[File:Adventures in Unova Collection 1.jpg|thumb|Pokémon: BW Adventures in Unova - Collection 1]] Pokémon: BW Adventures in Unova - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on February 5, 2014 and in New Zealand on February 19, 2014. It contains three discs with 25 episodes across them combined. ''[[BW142|The Dream Continues!]]'' |} ==Season 16 disc set== [[File:Adventures in Unova and Beyond disc set Region 4.jpg|thumb|DigiPack cover art]] The Season 16 DigiPack disc set was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on June 4, 2014 and in New Zealand on June 25, 2014. It contains six discs with 45 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE5184. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/980903292007738 on July 14, 2016] and in JB Hi-Fi stores [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/1034172803347453 on September 21, 2016] to celebrate the [[Pokémon 20th Anniversary]]. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case in Australia on June 1, 2015 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5987. ===Contents=== Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
